name: Figure 1
descr: Bar chart of process temperature ranges with LWR and HTR arrows.
credit: Figure 1. Process heat temperature ranges of industrial applications, with the ranges that light-water reactors (LWRs) and HTGRs can serve [7].

name: Figure 2
descr: Process flow diagram of the reactor, reformer, shift, capture, recycle and external PSA.
credit: Figure 2. NUS-H₂ arrangement. A 210  HTGR supplies 120.8  of process heat through an IHX and secondary helium circuit. The dashed line is the boundary: CO₂ compression and ship offshore storage sit inside it, the external PSA sits outside, and its reject returns across it.

name: Figure 3
descr: Frequency against dose plot with the target line.
credit: Figure 3. How an EPZ is set from dose. Each accident sequence is plotted by frequency and 30-day dose at 400 , the Xe-100 example, and must fall below the frequency-consequence target. Adapted from the Xe-100 construction permit application [27].
